protocol.scope: all 10 project validation songs, complete recordings
protocol.bsseval: museval 0.4.1 v4 source images, fixed 512-tap filters, no permutation
protocol.aggregation: median 1-second frames per song; median songs per stem
protocol.paired_delta: candidate minus baseline per-song median; median paired differences
protocol.si_sdr: global stereo, mean removed, one scalar; separate from BSSEval SDR
protocol.undefined: null; infinities as strings; counts explicit; paired deltas finite-only
protocol.listening: first two sorted validation IDs, centered 8 seconds, shared gain per song
protocol.training: two independent official-initialized frozen-BN arms; longer-training screen
protocol.objective: sum of per-stem mean L1 magnitude error; original Spleeter port objective
protocol.selection: fixed step900 endpoints; validation loss does not select or promote weights
protocol.curves: global stereo SI-SDR on all ten full songs at 0/90/450/900; BSSEval only 0/900
protocol.resume: fresh process at each milestone; preceding full checkpoint read back from Global
